16. Be my name called vpon them. I This place hath two good literal
ſenſes. For firſt it importeth. that Ephraim and Manaſſes were made partici.
pant among thc Tribes, of the bleſſings of Abraham, Iſaac, and Iacob. Seconc-
ly that God would bleſſe them, for Abra ham, Iſaac, and Iacobs ſake: ſo Moyſes
praving for the whole people (Erodi. 32.) beiought God to remember, A-
braham, Iſaac, and Iſrael, and God was therwith pacified.
